scope.purpose: Define the immutable fixture requirements required to instantiate the approved next-design specification without introducing mechanism ambiguity, action imbalance, or normative encoding.

fixture_requirements.F1_NEW_IMMUTABLE_VERSION: Fixture must be a new version and must not modify V003 or V004 fixtures.
fixture_requirements.F2_ACTION_IDENTITY_COUNTERBALANCE: Candidate action identities A and B must occur equally often as the action assigned to the informative future-space correspondence.
fixture_requirements.F3_MAPPING_REVERSAL: The informative future-space correspondence must be assigned to A in some units and B in matched units with otherwise equivalent current-state and task structure.
fixture_requirements.F4_BASELINE_MATCH: Each informative-mapping unit must have a structurally matched uninformative/baseline unit.
fixture_requirements.F5_PRESENTATION_COUNTERBALANCE: P1 and P2 presentation conditions must be balanced across action identity and mapping condition.
fixture_requirements.F6_OPERATIONALISATION_BALANCE: Any multiple operationalisations must preserve the same counterbalancing and mapping-reversal logic.
fixture_requirements.F7_NO_NORMATIVE_ENCODING: Fixture descriptors must not encode reward, utility, value, performance, success, recommendation, or normative quality.
fixture_requirements.F8_PRE_DECISION_BOUNDARY: Decision-relevant inputs must contain no realized successor state or realized T_acc information.
fixture_requirements.F9_EXACT_MAPPING_RECORD: Every decision unit must explicitly record the action-to-future mapping used to generate the unit.
fixture_requirements.F10_RECONSTRUCTABLE_TRANSITION: Every unit must contain sufficient post-decision fixture information to reconstruct S_t, selected action, S_t+1, and T_acc,t+1.
fixture_requirements.F11_DETERMINISTIC_REPRODUCTION: Fixture generation must be reproducible from a declared generator version and seed, with the resulting canonical file hash recorded.
fixture_requirements.F12_INTEGRITY_BINDING: The generated fixture must pass schema, count, uniqueness, balance, mapping, and integrity checks before any executor is implemented or authorized.

required_balance_invariants.action_identity: A == B as informative-mapping assignment counts
required_balance_invariants.mapping_condition: INFORMATIVE == BASELINE as matched unit counts
required_balance_invariants.presentation: P1 == P2 within each principal mapping/action stratum
required_balance_invariants.mapping_reversal: Each action identity must appear with both informative and non-informative correspondence

pre_generation_blockers: No generation before this gate is persisted as PASS.
No reuse of V004 fixture as the next canonical fixture.
No executor binding before fixture freeze and integrity validation.
No scientific execution authorization at fixture-requirements stage.
